## Verified shop information

- Phone: +1-901-718-5812
- Regular hours: Monday-Thursday 12-9 PM; Friday-Sunday 12-10 PM
- Products listed by the shop include hand-dipped ice cream, self-serve frozen yogurt with toppings, gelato, sorbetto or sorbet, milkshakes, and cookie-based loaded treats.

## Source guidance

Use the current in-stock menu for daily availability. Use the product catalogs for published nutrition, ingredient, and allergen details, retaining their cautions. Do not infer pricing, pricing method, parking, accessibility, payment methods, group services, delivery, special hours, offers, or dietary safety from this file.
